sources.quote: 'Citation tone [55] occurs only on checked syllables. Citation tones [...] occur on open syllables and closed syllables with a nasal ending. ... On compounds, before [...], [33] -> [...] and [...] -> [55] ... Citation tones [...] do not undergo tone sandhi before [55] or [33]. ... illustrate simultaneous tone sandhi application to tones on the non-compound-final syllables.' No mention of stress, accent, neutral tone or prominence anywhere in the 5-page article (a full-text search for stress/accent extracted text output: zero hits).
